oracle: Isolated CS2Script.decodeScript, CS2Executor.executeScript and MathStringOps.dispatch from the pre-existing compiled client jar; synthetic inputs written by tests/native/NativeFixtures.java; no game/client entry point or supplied cache used.
string_fixture_encoding: Each u-prefixed string is a lossless sequence of four hex digits per JVM UTF16 code unit, including lone surrogates; null is a separate literal. Input strings are representable Unicode; native unrepresentable outputs remain lossless in the oracle and must explicitly error in the Arc<str> VM.
character_fixture_encoding: Five bytes per UTF16 unit in increasing unsigned unit order: big-endian u16 lowercase, big-endian u16 uppercase, flags bits0..3 printable/alphanumeric/alpha/numeric.
character_case_semantics: Actual native MathStringOps CHAR_TOLOWERCASE/CHAR_TOUPPERCASE dispatch on JDK25 Character char overloads, Unicode16.0; int inputs truncate to16 bits. No Rust Unicode tables or locale defaults are used.

src/vm/char-lower.bin.encoding: Sorted nonidentity big-endian (u16 input,u16 output) pairs; missing keys map to themselves.

src/vm/char-upper.bin.encoding: Sorted nonidentity big-endian (u16 input,u16 output) pairs; missing keys map to themselves.

variable_fixture_encoding: Twelve tab-separated columns: opcode, operand ID, base varp, start, end, initial active, initial pending, store input or -, read result or -, final active, final pending, executed instructions. Start/end -1 mark direct varps or the native default varbit definition.
variable_native_seam: TypeLists.VAR=new VarpTypeList(null), PlayerVarDomain constructed then public activeVars/pendingVars replaced with 65536-element arrays, VarProviders.setPLAYER_VAR_PROVIDER(domain), TypeLists.VARPBIT=new VarpbitTypeList(null) with cache-seeded definitions. Each vector executes an actual decoded CS2 script via CS2Executor.executeScript, never the Rust implementation or a rewritten native mask formula. Cache-seeded new VarpbitType models only the already-proven absent-definition defaults, not unavailable repositories.
variable_native_coverage: All 528 spans within bits0..31 plus32..32,34..41,31..62,16..47,224..255,240..255,255..255; native signed and full-width mask boundaries; direct varp reads/writes; default varbit; base varp65535; active and pending intentionally differ. Combined vm-vars fixture chains reads and writes.
variable_native_limitations: Only executor stacks and active/pending values are compared; native update queue timestamps, 500ms protection, bot events and asynchronous service are not asserted. No client entry point, supplied cache, display, accounts, network or Kotlin build was used. Invalid IDs/spans are typed Rust boundary tests rather than native exception fixtures.
variable_native_reproduction: Verified copied jar SHA256 matches jar_sha256; regenerated the full fixture set and character tables into code/cs2/target/native-variables/full and tables, byte-for-byte equal to every installed fixture/table. --variables-only generation agrees with the full run.
